{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lorellian Court''' was an ultra-secret division of [[Hapan Security]]. This unit within the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] consisted of select members with little known of the group to outsiders.

[[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] knew only three things about the Court namely that she was forbidden to speak of its existence, that she could trust anyone that flashed the secret face-code and that she would be introduced to it on her eighteenth birthday. [[Trista Zel]], [[Taryn Zel]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Zekk]] were members of the Lorellian Court.
